event.distribution_pattern: Distributed to consumers at Dierbergs Market retail grocery stores.

products.product_description: Dierbergs Kitchen Kosher-Style Potato Salad, packaged in 12 OZ containers UPC 23753400000 and in bulk by pound containers UPC 23494500000
products.reason_for_recall: The firm received a recall notice for hardboiled eggs that were potentially contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes. The eggs were subsequently used to manufacture various salad and deli products.
